back: The Greek measuring option price sensitivity per $1 move in spot price (∂V/∂S), ranging from 0 to +1.0 for Calls and -1.0 to 0 for Puts.
The Greek measuring the rate of change of Delta per $1 move in spot price (∂²V/∂S²). It is highest for At-the-Money options near expiration.
The Greek measuring option price sensitivity to the passage of time (time decay). It is negative for option buyers as extrinsic value erodes.
The Greek measuring option price sensitivity to a 1% change in implied volatility (∂V/∂σ). Long options have positive Vega.
The Greek measuring option price sensitivity to a 1% change in the risk-free interest rate (∂V/∂r).
The forward-looking volatility value derived by taking an option's observed market price and solving backward through a pricing model like Black-Scholes.
